title.zh: 多线程测速骗局大揭秘：为什么 Speedtest 跑出 2Gbps 却看不了 YouTube 4K 视频？
title.en: Multi-Thread Speedtest Deception: Why 2Gbps Synthetic Scores Still Buffer YouTube 4K

cluster.zh: 晚高峰单线程测速天梯集群

description.zh: 深度解析 TCP 窗口缩放因子、拥塞避免算法（Cubic vs BBR）与多并发套接字聚合机制，揭穿测速软件如何用虚高数字掩盖晚高峰严重丢包，助你掌握识别假测速的核心技巧。
description.en: A technical deep dive into TCP window scaling, Cubic vs BBR congestion control, and multi-socket aggregation, explaining how synthetic speedtests mask severe peak-hour packet drops.
